def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    fg = next(v for v in range(10) if v != bg and any(v in row for row in grid))
    # Mark the unfilled continuation to the right of the short horizontal run
    # in the topmost motif, as illustrated by the final demo motif.
    candidates = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v == fg for v in row)]
    for r in candidates:
        cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v == fg]
        if cols and cols == list(range(min(cols), max(cols)+1)):
            # topmost occurrence has an incomplete rightward run
            c = max(cols) + 1
            while c < len(out[r]) and out[r][c] == bg:
                out[r][c] = 1
                c += 1
            break
    return out
PY
